game.q: the warning reaches the king of nineveh. what does he do?
opts: bans the foreign prophet from town
leaves his throne and sits in ashes

wrong.pr: no spin. he went straight to the ashes.

game.right: YES. robe off, sackcloth on, down in the ashes. then a fast for everyone, even the flocks.

end.line: no promise, no “unless.” a whole city turned anyway, and the disaster never came.
